description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing Entity Data Table Checks in the Apache Fineract project. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving templates, creating, and deleting entity datatable checks, and leverages Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: EntityDatatableChecksApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints for managing Entity Data Table Checks, including listing, template retrieval, creation, and deletion. Uses dependency injection for required services and Swagger annotations for documentation.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all entity datatable checks with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a template for entity datatable checks to aid UI building.

methods.name: createEntityDatatableCheck
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new entity datatable check based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: deleteDatatable
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete an existing entity datatable check identified by its ID.
